sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Commencing Alpha Route. Continuing patrols and ensuring a visible presence along Queen Street.
Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Brief standby to ensure our presence is known.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; quick scope of the area, all clear. Standing by to show presence and awaiting response calls.
No issues occurred during the standby.
Walkthrough of the Bledisloe Building alleyway; no vagrants or issues identified.
Arrived at the Elliott Street Apartments check-in; welfare check within Atrium on Elliott, making our way up towards the Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.
Welfare check at City Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street check-in; welfare check commenced on all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to maintain a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Patrolling down Albert Street ensuring a visible presence.
Welfare check at Formery and Little Albert's Coffee, all clear.
Welfare check at Hollywood Bakery, all clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Customs Street and Albert Street check-in; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check at Woolworths Metro and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough completed around and within the location, checked in on stores within the area, no reports or issues.
Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Call from Management requesting timesheets be handed over at HQ.
Commencing Delta Route. Welfare check at Movenpick Hotel, Daily Bread and 4 Square, all clear.
Arrived at the Kiwibank check-in; welfare checks commenced on all nearby stores, all clear.

Arrived at the Bottom of Fort Street check-in; welfare checks commenced on all stores and businesses within the area, all clear. Standing by to ensure a visible presence while awaiting response calls.

Response call from Acceco Supermarket reporting an incident from the previous day (Sunday, approximately 15:00): a male individual came into the store and took a store employee's backpack. The incident has been reported to Police; the team was asked to keep an eye out for this individual.

Report relayed by Management requiring a follow-up check at the vape store on Tyler Street regarding an incident on Saturday in which a group of minors committed theft and caused damage within the property — over $1,000 worth of goods and vapes taken. Video and photos to be sent through once the CCTV review is complete.

Arrived at the response location (vape store / 77 Convenience Store, Tyler Street); follow-up check completed. Advised staff to install automatic access doors allowing employees to control entry and exit for greater control over the premises. No further issues. Continuing to stand by to ensure a stronger security presence.
Welfare check along Fort Lane and Snickel Lane, all clear.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, no issues found.
Arrived at the Wilson Carpark check-in; welfare checks commenced on all stores and businesses within the location, all clear. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Welfare check commenced on High Street, O'Connell Street and Vulcan Lane stores, all clear.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; sweep completed within the vicinity and checked in on stores open at this time, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Welfare check continuing along upper High Street.
Arrived at HQ; standing by for any further incidents.
Resuming patrols up Queen Street, conducting welfare checks on all stores and businesses and ensuring a strong security presence. Welfare check, all clear:
Scoped out Darby Street for any concerns; a few street vagrants sitting just to the side of Ippondo, but no issues identified.

Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full sweep within the location, checked in on the Aotea Centre and Jack's Fried Chicken, all clear. Standing by to maintain a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Commencing Echo Route. Walkthrough along Greys Avenue; arrived at the Top of Mayoral Drive check-in, area thoroughly checked for any issues, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Airedale Suites, Queens Food Court, Munster Inn and Nandos, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street check-in, no issues found. Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses along Lorne Street; water fountain area cleared.
Commencing welfare checks on High Street stores and businesses, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and the Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall, no issues found.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; commenced welfare checks on all stores within the vicinity, all clear. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Arrived at Fort Street; welfare check on the static guards and stores within the location.
Arrived at the Bottom of Fort Street check-in; standing by to ensure our presence is known.
Stopped and had a chat with Giapo, all clear.
Arrived at the Kiwibank check-in, all clear. Quick scope of the area completed, no issues found.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough commenced and swept for any problematic issues or vagrants, all clear.
Commencing patrols and ensuring a strong presence along Queen Street while making our way to HQ for the lunch break.
Arrived at HQ; standing by for lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Morning shift completed; changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)

Debrief with the Morning Shift regarding the morning status of the CBD and any incidents to be aware of. Standing by at HQ to charge the Ops Phone to a healthy percentage before commencing routes, to avoid having to return during peak times (17%, shown on camera).
Commencing Alpha Route along the main strip of Queen Street due to heavy foot traffic — most calls come from stores along the main strip. Ops Phone at 32%.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street check-in, all clear; construction ongoing and foot traffic busy.
Standing by at the corner of Durham Street West and Queen Street to show presence before moving along.
Standing by at Vulcan Lane to show presence while awaiting any response calls or incidents.
Standing by at the corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, awaiting response calls while remaining vigilant.
Welfare check — Imperial Lane building sweep, all clear.
Welfare check at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full sweep around the area, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, Starbucks, Kowhai Cafe, Queens Rooftop and Wine Shop, Dos Donkey and Rodd & Gunn The Lodge Commercial Bay, all clear.
Standing by to show presence before moving to the next checkpoint.
Response call from UGG Express Queen Street regarding a theft; assistance requested.

Arrived at the response call; the individual had already left. The theft had occurred earlier and was only reported after being picked up on the store's security cameras — staff had not noticed at the time. The stolen item was a bag.
As we arrived, the fire alarm for the whole building block went off; standing by to show presence.
Response call from Good To Go Supermarket regarding a theft in store; assistance requested.
Arrived at the response call; staff pointed out which way the individuals were headed and requested we track them down and retrieve any further items they might have taken.
Tracked both individuals down and conducted bag searches; no sign of any further items. Notified staff, who were thankful for our services.

Individuals have left; standing by to show presence at the corner of Wyndham Street and Albert Street. Staff advised these individuals usually double back and try again — this is the second or third incident involving them.
Response call from Ansh at Auckland Council requesting assistance with trespassing an individual from Queens Jewellery.
Arrived at the response call; Auckland Council requested we issue the individual a verbal trespass on camera, after which they would move him along.
Verbal trespass issued; the individual complied when approached by Auckland Council.
Leaving standby shortly to conduct mandatory HQ floor checks.
Response call from the Cotton On manager regarding three females who stole hoodies and other accessories; assistance requested to track them down and recover the items.
Tracked the three female individuals to the top of Wyndham Street and recovered the items.
Arrived back at Cotton On and returned the items to staff.
Returning to Headquarters to continue charging the Ops Phone (13%).
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone (18:46–19:30).
Ops Phone at 34%; back on routes.
Welfare check through Mid City Arcade, all clear.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables and all businesses within the vicinity, all clear.
Standing by to show presence before continuing patrols.
Response call from Trevor at Chemist Warehouse regarding a disorderly individual in store; assistance requested to stand by outside in case their security guard needs help.
Response message from Mitchell (HOTC) regarding an aggressively loud male individual at Freyberg Square.
Called Mitchell asking for a description of the individual; he did not get a clear look as he was walking past.
Arrived at the Chemist Warehouse response call; standing by outside in case our help is needed.
During the standby, Trevor brought out a needle that the individual had been carrying.
Standing by while Trevor is on the phone to Police; the individual is still in store, scoping the aisles.
Police arrived on scene; standing by in case they need our assistance as well.
Police escorted the individual out of the premises.
No altercation with the individual; both the team and Police have left the response call.
Arrived at Freyberg Square and scanned the area for the individual reported shouting; no sign of him due to the lack of a description.
Welfare check around the nearby businesses, all clear.
Welfare check at Chubby Boy, Dong De Moon, Machi Machi and Dilruba Shisha Lounge, all clear.
Welfare check at Oodles, Grilled Planet BBQ, Meet Fresh, Chongcha, Red Radisson and Pork BBQ Rice, all clear.
Welfare check and standby at the Lorne Street fountain.
Welfare check at Choice Backpackers, all clear.
Standing by in the middle of Queen Street, awaiting response calls while remaining vigilant.
Meal break completed; standing by for changeover to the Night Shift.
Response message from Jo & Joes regarding a male individual out front bothering customers.
Arrived and asked the individuals to leave the premises, to which they complied.

Standing by at Headquarters while charging the Ops Phone.
Welfare checks at McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store Queen Street completed; all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed; all clear, no issues to report. Remaining available for calls.
Wellesley Street West checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Federal Street, SkyCity and surrounding areas checked; all clear, no issues to report.
77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street checked; all clear, no issues to report.

Albert Street Mart and Albert Street checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Bus terminal on Lower Albert Street checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Commercial Bay checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart completed; all clear, no issues to report. Remaining available for calls.
Call received from McDonald's Britomart regarding an individual sleeping inside the restaurant; responded to the call.
The individual was moved from the premises without incident; remaining available for further calls.
Fort Lane checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Wilson Carpark on Gore Street checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Jo & Joes, Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall and Chancery Square checked; all clear, no issues to report.
High Street checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Red Radisson completed; all clear, no issues to report.
Lorne Street checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; observed two males appearing to be involved in a verbal disagreement. Maintained a visible security presence to monitor the situation and prevent escalation.
No further issues observed at McDonald's Queen Street; proceeding back to Headquarters for a break.
Arrived at Headquarters for a break while remaining available for calls.
Remaining at Headquarters, available for calls and preparing for handover to the Morning Shift.
Shift handover to the morning team completed; no major issues reported.
